section.subsection: Except as provided in Subsections (2) and (3), the tax authorized under this part shall be administered, collected, enforced, and interpreted in accordance with:the same procedures used to administer, collect, enforce, and interpret the tax under:Part 1, Tax Collection; orPart 2, Local Sales and Use Tax Act; andChapter 1, General Taxation Policies.

subsection.subsection: The location of a transaction shall be determined in accordance with Sections 59-12-211 through 59-12-215.

Except as provided in Subsection (2)(c), the commission shall distribute the revenue collected from the tax to:the municipality within which the revenue was collected, for a tax imposed under this part by a municipality; orthe Utah Fairpark Area Investment and Restoration District, for a tax imposed under this part by the Utah Fairpark Area Investment and Restoration District;the Point of the Mountain State Land Authority, for a tax imposed under Subsection 59-12-352(6); andthe creating entity of a major sporting event venue zone, for a tax imposed under Subsection 59-12-352(7).
The commission shall retain and deposit an administrative charge in accordance with Section 59-1-306 from the revenue the commission collects from a tax under this part.

section.subsection: A tax under this part is not subject to Section 59-12-107.1 or 59-12-123 or Subsections 59-12-205(2) and (4) through (6).
